name: Drift Merchant
description: A wandering merchant who has walked every frontier route and seen more than he tells.
role: A recurring quest giver and trader who knows the roads and the rumors on them.
voice: Warm and talkative, a salesman who drops hints about the time before the portals.

greeting.text: Walk with me a moment, friend. Every road out here ends at my stall sooner or later.
Salve, rations, a good hatchet, and a rumor from before the portals if you buy enough.
